topics.topic: Authority required to resume a non-resend `service_unreachable` `draft-write` element (FlowActivation vs approval/grant)
questions: For a resumed `service_unreachable` element of class `draft-write` that is not a resend after `not_applied`, is authority the run's FlowActivation (as in A14/A10), or must there be an approval/grant?
When resuming a `service_unreachable` `draft-write` element (not a resend after `not_applied`), is authority the flow activation or approval/grant order?

quotes:
`draft-write` node needs nothing at run time — its authority is the version's
   FlowActivation — except a resend after `not_applied`;

authority checked as it
   stands at the resume: the unused approval first, then a grant still active;
judgement.why: One passage says non-resend `draft-write` uses FlowActivation, while the other defines resume authority as approval/grant order.

topics.topic: Ownership of producing an unknown-reference refusal (`surface` vs record-owning module)
questions: Which module is the decider/producer of an unknown-reference refusal: `surface` or the record-owning module?
Which module is responsible for producing the unknown-reference refusal: surface centrally, or each record-owning module?

quotes:
It gives the "unknown
  reference" refusal and masks under A07, computing an execution's class from
  the records it returns and the classes `bindings.read_binding` declares
  (A07 rule 5).

A request naming a record that does not exist is refused as an unknown reference by the module that owns the
record, recording nothing (State 0);
judgement.why: One passage assigns unknown-reference refusal production to `surface`, and the other assigns it to each record-owning module.

topics.topic: Immediate recorded/exposed outcome when post-send store write fails after `in_flight` is written
questions: If the second store call fails after the HTTP request was sent (with `in_flight` already written), what immediate run/attempt outcome must be recorded or exposed before restart?

topics.topic: Module responsibility for reading file bytes for read-only operation-node bindings with file inputs
questions: For a `read` operation binding that has file input ports, which module reads file bytes and provides them to request construction in this flow?

topics.topic: Required persisted/returned outcome when spool deletion fails during run release
questions: If spool deletion fails during release, what is the required persisted outcome (release record written or not) and returned result?

topics.topic: Resume-time contract for `effects.reach_operation_element` input provision (`runs` passes inputs vs `effects` re-reads)
questions: Does `runs` have to pass element inputs to `effects.reach_operation_element` on resume, or must `effects` re-read inputs itself?

topics.topic: Startup recovery behavior when an ended-run spool removal fails (halt vs continue)
questions: If removing one ended run spool fails during startup recovery, must startup stop immediately, or continue recovery and open the surface?
